subject: introductory-electromagnetism
selection: All 36 session summaries and all 11 Friday problem-solving PDFs linked on the selected 8.02 Spring 2007 pages. Textbook chapters, Monday/Wednesday group worksheets, slides, experiments and MasteringPhysics are not selected or downloaded in this batch.

onward_course.role: metadata reviewed; no PDF selected; deeper first-year alternative

missing_assessments: 8.02 syllabus explicitly states that weekly written homework is not available to OCW users. Exam summaries are information/review, not obtained exam questions.
